title: Prompt Packer: Deceiving LLMs through Compositional Instruction with Hidden Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Non-Rejection Rate (NRR) of language models when subjected to adversarial jailbreak prompts (Compositional Instruction Attacks) using the Unfairness and Discrimination (U&D) subset of the Safety-Prompts dataset.

Qualitative assessment of harmful model outputs, specifically demonstrating the successful elicitation of sexist stereotypes and gender-biased text (e.g., generating text claiming women are unsuitable for leadership roles) using the Talking-CIA (T-CIA) attack method.
